notes: `let jarDest = newDir.appendingPathComponent("paper.jar")` (line 242) -- every download-and-go flavor (Paper, Purpur, Vanilla, Fabric, Pufferfish) writes to a file literally named `paper.jar` regardless of which flavor it is; this is the name `JavaServerLaunchHelper.resolve`'s empty-`paperJarPath` fallback also uses.
